title: Site telemetry event contract v1
description: Versioned telemetry envelope for the Parlour admin site (parlour-asset-review) and the Parlour product. OWNED FILE (one writer). additionalProperties:false is load-bearing: the contract is a closed allow-list, so raw request variables, headers, cookies, tokens and free-form user content have nowhere to land. Correlation identity is trace_id (browser -> API -> queue -> Leviath); retry/reconnect is joinable by (trace_id, attempt) and de-duplicated by event_id.

v.description: contract version; a new shape requires v2, never a silent field

ts.description: server receive time, epoch seconds (reader's clock is authoritative)

client_ts.description: client clock, kept only so drift is measurable

route.description: bounded PATH ONLY. No query string, no fragment, no '='. Raw request variables are not representable.

op.description: named GraphQL operation, or a named UI action. Never a document body.

action.description: bounded UI action name, e.g. desk.claim, proposal.approve

err_class.description: exception CLASS name only. A message can carry thread text across a public seam.

actor_ref.description: pseudonymous actor handle, salted hash of the identity; never the identity

session_ref.description: pseudonymous session handle; the join key for UI -> API inside one visit

trace_id.description: bounded correlation id spanning browser -> API -> queue -> Leviath

run_ref.description: Leviath run id (or a bounded reference to it), not a path and not an argv

event_id.description: client-assigned id; the de-duplication key that stops a reconnected beacon double-counting

seq.description: monotonic within (trace_id, session_ref); with event_id it fences a replayed spool flush

attempt.description: 0 for the first try; a reconnect/retry is attempt+1 with the SAME trace_id

continuation.description: true when this event is another attempt at work already traced; usage/completion must count it once

legacy.description: true for a route/endpoint on the retirement list (adds a usage counter, nothing else)

detail.description: bounded, allow-listed detail only. Unknown keys are dropped by the store, never widened.
